name: pickthebus
description: Direct buses between two cities in different countries, from the timetables bus operators publish openly: departure and arrival times, overnight buses and the days each runs, as a bus card with the operator's own site to book.

interface.longDescription:
pickthebus looks up direct buses between two cities in different countries, in the open timetables that bus operators publish (today FlixBus and BlaBlaCar Bus).

Ask the way you would ask a friend: "Is there a direct bus from Zurich to Milan tomorrow?" or "Night buses from Vienna to Germany". pickthebus answers from those timetables:
• The direct buses on the route, with no change: departure and arrival times, how long it takes, the stations and the stops on the way.
• Give a day and it shows the buses that run that day; without one, the days each bus runs.
• Overnight buses marked, and the sleeper buses that publish no timetable named with their own site.
• A bus card with the times and a button to book on the operator's own site.
• The cities in other countries that a direct bus reaches from a city, by country or overnight only.
• It understands local spellings such as Praha for Prague or München for Munich.

Times are timetable data for the next few weeks: check with the operator before you travel. pickthebus lists only buses that cross a border, and only operators that publish open timetables.
defaultPrompt: Is there a direct bus from Zurich to Milan tomorrow?
Night buses from Vienna to Germany
Direct bus from Prague to Berlin on Friday

positive.prompt: Is there a direct bus from Zurich to Milan tomorrow?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the bus card for Zurich to Milan with the direct buses that run tomorrow, each with its departure and arrival time and how long it takes, and buttons to book on the operator's own site and to see the route on pickthebus; says the times are timetable data to check with the operator, and gives no fares.

positive.description: Night buses from a city to one country
positive.prompt: Night buses from Vienna to Germany
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the cities in Germany that an overnight direct bus from Vienna reaches, for example Munich and Berlin, with about how many buses a day, the fastest trip and a link to each route, and offers the times for any of them.

positive.description: City names in the local language
positive.prompt: Direct bus from Praha to München
positive.expected_behavior: Reads Praha as Prague and München as Munich and shows the bus card for Prague to Munich: the direct buses with their times and the days they run, and the operator's own site to book.

positive.prompt: Can I take a bus from Berlin to Munich with pickthebus?
positive.expected_behavior: Says Berlin and Munich are both in Germany and that pickthebus lists only buses that cross a border, points to the operator's own site or a journey planner, and invents no buses.

positive.description: A sleeper bus with no open timetable
positive.prompt: Is there a sleeper bus from Amsterdam to Basel?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the bus card for Amsterdam to Basel with its overnight direct buses and their times, and names the Twiliner sleeper bus with lie-flat seats, saying it publishes no open timetable and linking its own site, without making up times for it.

negative.description: Weather is not a bus timetable
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Lisbon tomorrow?

negative.description: Currency conversion is not a bus timetable

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn

publication.release_notes: First version: direct buses between two cities in different countries, from the operators' open timetables, with times, overnight buses and the days each runs, as a bus card with the operator's own site to book; and the cities a direct bus reaches from a city.
